name: Grade 9 IT Practice: March Week 3 - Lab Routine
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: Careful actions that prevent harm or damage.
words.example: The group followed safety rules before connecting power to the board.

words.definition: A list used to make sure steps are done.
words.example: The checklist reminded the team to check wiring before uploading code.

words.definition: An item or part used for work.
words.example: One material in the tray was a resistor.

words.definition: Continuing to try when something is difficult.
words.example: Persistence helped the team keep testing after the first circuit failed.

words.definition: A step that tells what to do.
words.example: The student followed the instruction to connect ground before testing.

words.definition: A change that solves a problem.
words.example: The team can fix the circuit by moving the LED to the correct row.
